_comment: Regression fixture — a deliberately broken scene. Copy it into a scratch scenes/ folder and run validate-scenes.mjs: it must report all 11 errors across existence, canonical, ops, purity and lifecycle. FMA7196 is the SPLEEN; the v1 heart scene labelled it 'left lung'. If this fixture ever passes, the gate is broken.
blocked_reason: [existence] heart: FMA7088 is NOT in available-meshes.json — the model does not exist. Never invent an id.
[canonical] lung_l: name mismatch — scene says "left lung", catalog says "spleen" for FMA7196. This is how a spleen ends up labelled "lung".
[existence] ra: FMA7096 is NOT in available-meshes.json — the model does not exist. Never invent an id.
[ops] view "t" · SHOW_STRUCTURE: target "nonexistent" matches no structure key or group
[purity] the scene contains a URL — delivery belongs to the adapter, not the scene
[purity] the scene contains a file extension (.stl) — delivery belongs to the adapter, not the scene
[purity] the scene contains a CDN host — delivery belongs to the adapter, not the scene
[purity] the scene contains a delivery field — delivery belongs to the adapter, not the scene
[purity] the scene names a provider outside provider{} and refs{} — a scene should not know who renders it
